summary: Iteration 3 testing of AutoLenis public pages, inventory API, vehicle detail API, affiliate register, dealer signin, and admin refinance rates. Found and fixed a critical bug: /dealer/signin was redirecting to the generic Supabase auth form instead of showing the custom dark two-panel dealer portal, due to missing DEALER_AUTH_ROUTES exemption in proxy.ts middleware and DealerLayout calling requireDealer() unconditionally. Bug was fixed by adding isDealerAuthRoute() to proxy.ts and adding x-dealer-auth-route header check in DealerLayout. All 16 test scenarios pass post-fix.

minor.issue: Returns 400 VALIDATION_ERROR when required fields (name, rating, category) are missing. Correct behavior but docs should clarify required schema. Returns 201 with proper payload.

integration_issues.issue: FIXED: /dealer/signin was redirecting to /auth/signin (Supabase generic form) due to missing DEALER_AUTH_ROUTES exemption in proxy.ts. DealerLayout called requireDealer() for all /dealer/* routes including /dealer/signin, creating infinite redirect. Fixed by adding DEALER_AUTH_ROUTES + isDealerAuthRoute() to proxy.ts and checking x-dealer-auth-route header in DealerLayout to skip auth check.

action_items: Verify /dealer/signin fix is working in production (proxy.ts DEALER_AUTH_ROUTES + dealer layout x-dealer-auth-route header check)
critical_code_review_comments: proxy.ts was missing /dealer/signin in any auth-exempt list — same pattern already applied for admin routes but not for dealer routes. Fix is now in place.
DealerLayout should mirror AdminLayout pattern: check x-dealer-auth-route header before calling requireDealer(). This is now implemented.

The affiliate/register form HTML5 required attribute fires before React handleSubmit — HTML5 browser native validation handles empty fields, React validation handles logic constraints (FTC checkbox). Both working correctly.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Dealer signin bug was fixed in this iteration — /dealer/signin now shows the custom dark two-panel dealer portal instead of redirecting to the Supabase generic auth form. The fix added DEALER_AUTH_ROUTES to proxy.ts and isDealerAuthRoute() function, plus updated DealerLayout to check x-dealer-auth-route header before calling requireDealer(). All public pages, inventory API, vehicle detail, affiliate register, and CSRF-exempt public APIs are working correctly. rca_of_the_issue.bug: Dealer signin page (/dealer/signin) showed Supabase generic auth form instead of custom dark two-panel dealer portal
reproduction_steps: 2. Page redirects to /auth/signin (Supabase generic auth page) instead of showing custom dealer form
rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: proxy.ts middleware had no exemption for /dealer/signin. The path matched no public/auth routes, so the middleware redirected unauthenticated users to /auth/signin. Even if it had passed through, DealerLayout called requireDealer() unconditionally for ALL /dealer/* routes including /dealer/signin — which would have redirected to /dealer/signin again creating an infinite loop.
rca_of_the_issue.fix_applied: 1. Added DEALER_AUTH_ROUTES = ['/dealer/signin'] constant to proxy.ts. 2. Added isDealerAuthRoute() function to proxy.ts. 3. Updated step 5 of proxy.ts to set x-dealer-auth-route: true header for dealer auth routes. 4. Updated DealerLayout to import headers() from next/headers, check x-dealer-auth-route header, and skip requireDealer() when on the signin page.
rca_of_the_issue.mitigation: The fix follows the exact same pattern already established for admin auth routes (x-admin-auth-route header). Dealer portal is now fully accessible via the correct signin page.
